subject: governance/pyxis-contract-proposals
statement: During Pyxis's move to semantic memory, its docgate umbrella skips legacy document checks but retains Argus attribution, authority-contract structure, add-only ledger history, and delivery-ledger citation checks; installed document-pipeline repositories continue to run the full umbrella.
intent: Let existing-feature corrections proceed without legacy document rules while preserving Argus integrity controls and the memory and code gates.
rationale: The operator directed disabling the old document gate; review showed that the active Argus checks protect authorship, authority data, and ledger history and citations independently of those legacy rules.

provenance.note: Operator direction and review corrections in the Pyxis #1311 work session on 2026-09-29.
